title: He Did NOTHING in Our Group Project… So I Set a Trap
hook: He did NOTHING for 6 weeks… then took the credit
story: In my group project, one guy did absolutely nothing for six weeks. Then, the night before it was due, he emailed our professor saying he'd done most of the work. I didn't argue. I just made one small change. In the speaker notes for slide nine, I added a single sentence. The next day, he volunteered to present the whole thing alone, to "save us time." He'd never opened the file before, so he just read the speaker notes, word for word, sounding super confident. Slide seven. Slide eight. Slide nine. And then he read it. Out loud. To the professor. "If you're reading this out loud, you didn't make these slides." The room went dead silent. The professor smiled, opened the edit history on the projector, and asked him one question: "Which slide did you make?" He couldn't name a single one. He got a zero. And I got the best grade of my life… all because one guy in my group project did absolutely nothing.
